description: Benign inputs for the ffmpeg/libvpx port (tracker item I7). Each case is a frame size and the frame counts to run. The frames are synthetic (integration/ffmpeg_libvpx/vpx_workload.h); each is encoded with VP8 and the resulting packets are decoded again. The expectation is the output of the native build of the same libvpx revision with the same C-only target; no value is written by hand.
